articles.title_en: The final toll from Russia’s bombing of an aid site in the Zaporizhzhia region village of Komyshuvakha is 72. Only the Mariupol drama theater strike is believed to have killed more.
articles.lead_en: Search and rescue work has ended in the village of Komyshuvakha, in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia region, after a Russian strike on a humanitarian aid distribution point on November 2. The death toll from the strike has risen to 72, Ukrainian Interior Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi said.
